title: ID0429191-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312562229/30] Screensaver not showing
description:
Reported behavior/issue:   The terminal doesn't have screensavers. It should normally have them. When it's in standby mode, it just displays a blue screen.
Can you please add them? Please contact the Siemens France teams to obtain these screensavers.
